market_question: Will Example State certify the Metro Rail funding package by July 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves Yes if Example State publishes an official certification or final approval notice for the Metro Rail funding package on or before 2026-07-31. Draft notices, committee recommendations, or unofficial social posts do not resolve the market.

sources.title: Example State Budget Office funding certification calendar
sources.excerpt_or_note: [YES] Official calendar lists final Metro Rail funding certification vote for 2026-06-15 and notes certification package is complete.

sources.title: Example Superior Court docket entry denying emergency stay
sources.excerpt_or_note: [YES] Court docket note says the emergency stay request was denied without prejudice, removing the main procedural blocker before the certification deadline.

sources.title: Local News: budget committee advances Metro Rail funding package
sources.excerpt_or_note: [YES] Local reporting says the committee vote was 9-2 and quoted both chamber leaders saying floor passage is expected in May.

sources.title: Analyst memo: remaining administrative risk for Metro Rail package
sources.excerpt_or_note: [NO] Analysis notes certification could slip if bond counsel asks for another debt-service revision before publication.
